name: Dieter Müller
forbes_bio: Dieter Muller is the co-founder of European budget hotel chain Motel One.
Muller and partner Philippe Weyland created the concept for the business in 1999 and opened their first property in Frankfurt-Offenbach one year later.
Motel One investors have included German software billionaire Dietmar Hopp and a Morgan Stanley real estate fund that acquired a 35% stake in 2007.
Muller signed an agreement to sell a majority stake in 2025 that valued the business at 3.5 billion euros. He Still owns 6% plus 40% of its real estate portfolio.

name: Rakesh Chopdar
forbes_bio: Rakesh Chopdar is the founder and chairman of Hyderabad-based Azad Engineering, which makes parts for commercial and military aircraft.
The company has four factories in Hyderabad and its clients include Honeywell, Siemens Energy and General Electric.
It also makes aerodynamics blades and vanes that are used inside gas and nuclear turbines.
Azad Engineering got listed in December 2023 and raised $90 million.
forbes_facts: His wife Jyoti is a whole-time director on the company's board
More than 90% of the company's revenue comes from exports. It sells in 17 countries including USA, U.K, China and Japan.
He started working at 16 in his father's nuts and bolts manufacturing workshop.

name: Lyu Yixiong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2025-2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2021-2022)
forbes_bio: Lyu Yixiong is the CEO of Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic, a cosmetics supplier in China.
Chicmax went public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in December 2022.
Lyu completed executive management training at the Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business.

name: Wang Qiangxiang
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2022); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Wang Qiangxiang chairs CoCreation Grass, or CCGrass, a leading global supplier of artificial grass.
CCGrass is used for athletic and landscape purposes.
The company supplies to sports organizations such as FIFA, FIH and World Rugby.
CCGrass was founded by Wang Qiangxiang and his brother Wang Qiangzhong in 2004 in Nanjing city.

name: Lee Seung-gun
forbes_bio: Lee Seung-gun is the founder and CEO of Viva Republica, which operates the Korean finance app Toss.
In 2021, Viva Republica raised more than $400 million in a financing round that valued the company at over $7 billion.
Viva Republica's investors include PayPal, Singapore sovereign-wealth fund GIC and venture capital firm Kleiner Perkins.
Before starting Viva Republica in 2013, Lee was a dentist at a hospital affiliated with the Samsung Group.

name: Christian Sinding
forbes_bio: Christian Sinding is a private equity executive and former CEO of EQT, one of the world's largest PE firms.
He joined EQT in 1998 after working as a consultant at McKinsey & Company.
Sinding spent more than two decades helping build EQT into a global buyout powerhouse with investments across Europe, North America and Asia.
He became CEO in 2019, the same year EQT went public on the Stockholm Stock Exchange.
He stepped down as CEO in 2025, and was succeeded by fellow billionaire Per Franzén.

name: Donald Sihombing
forbes_bio: Donald Sihombing founded and runs Indonesian construction outfit, PT Totalindo Eka Persada, which built the Jakarta Four Seasons, among much else.
A US-educated civil engineer, he worked in construction before setting up his own company in 1995 and building what was then Southeast Asia's largest mall.
Since its June 2017 IPO, Totalindo's share price has soared, registering a ten-fold increase at its peak. Sihombing owns 74%.
Under a government program, Totalindo is diversifying into low-income housing to offset volatility in high-end projects.

name: Yang Erzhu
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2018-2022); Hurun Global (2018-2023); Hurun China (2008-2022)
forbes_bio: Yang Erzhu retired from real estate developer Country Garden Holdings in 2015 after a long career at the company.
Yang graduated from the School of Economic Management of Jinan University.

name: Wang Xiaokun
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026); Hurun China (2023-2025); Hurun Unicorn founders (2024)
forbes_bio: Wang Xiaokun chairs Chengdu-based Baicha Baidao, a tea drinks chain under the brand ChaPanda.
Wang and his wife Liu Weihong opened the first ChaPanda shop in 2008, before expanding to more than 7,000 stores across China.
Best known for its taro milk tea and jasmine milk green tea, ChaPanda's products retail for no more than $3.6 a cup.
Liu also holds a stake in the company and serves as its supervisor.
Baicha Baidao filed for an IPO on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in August 2023.

China SCE was established in 1996 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2010.
Huang holds an EMBA from Xiamen University.
